race.comment: GOSPEL GIRL (3) has a handy record over this distance range with four wins and seven placings from 17 attempts and will strip fitter second-up from the spell. Gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim and must be respected out of the Gollan camp. Should prove very hard to hold out. KINGDOM UNDERSIEGE (7) is a bit hit or miss but has won two from four over this trip and is more than capable enough on his day. Can feature if he brings his A-game. MISHANI CROWN (6) goes well for hoop Kendal who has three wins and a placing from nine steers and again gets the benefit of her claim. Top-three candidate. PROVANCE (8) next in line with Rodd in the saddle.
